interfaces.raw: One extraction per canonical group hop, shared by retained spans. Two bin passes summarize/validate spectra and compute centroid/spread/fractions; envelope differences and flux are available to downstream cache consumers. No NSGT/group inference or per-path spectral extraction.
interfaces.cut: Full raw supporting-audio endpoint and actual availability must precede the observation cutoff. Unavailable predecessor masks only differences. Keep original raw endpoint time even when assignment support is clipped.
interfaces.partial_acquisition: Union known integer sample intervals. A partially acquired hop masks acoustic values; clipped actual observed duration remains separate from missing seconds. Never uniformly spread a partial acquisition weight across a clipped interval.
interfaces.cadence: Generation-first canonical grid, 2 hops per block, 1/4 sensitivity. Span ends/gaps close partial blocks. Coalesce adjacent gaps; no generated hop fill. Each eligible raw record consumed once; conflicting/stale delivery or generation reuse is rejected.
interfaces.compression: 128 knots, one bounded insertion scratch, first/newest protected. Merge earliest minimum standardized error-increase adjacent interior pair, at most126 pairs. Weighted f64 W/mean/S retains within-block and between-block error; missing values contribute no W.
interfaces.timing: Representative time is weighted original raw-endpoint time; no observation gives physical-support midpoint. Acquisition gap OR survives merging and blocks tempo evidence. Mixed missing/observed blocks flag lost gap location.
interfaces.coverage: Coordinate W divided by physical block length, strict coverage<0.9 masks match value. Keep moment/error even when match value is masked; missing intervals remain in the denominator.
interfaces.error: Accumulated sum_blocks,j S_j/sd_j^2, measured against direct uncompressed f64 reconstruction. This is integrated observed-seconds times standardized squared error, not a pointwise/timing upper bound or auditory forgetting.
interfaces.freeze: finish flushes bounded partial/gap blocks and freezes append/update methods; detached bytes/snapshots retain original support. Scales are fixed per descriptor; rebuilding is required after a scale revision.
interfaces.storage: 320-byte knot: ten f64 W/mean/S triples240, representative time/observed seconds16, six f64 support/provenance/gap quantities48, epoch/generation u64 handles16. Fixed bytearray bank plus one insertion and two pending records. Python objects/headers/raw caches/exports are additional, not hidden inside the payload claim.
interfaces.query_support: Maximum full source endpoint over supported raw observations; later shorter windows and gap tails cannot refresh or hide support. Detached packed query export and queue/cache are registered separately.
interfaces.snapshot_read: One little-endian38f64+2u64 read supplies every existing DescriptorKnot snapshot field. Preserve arithmetic order, all masks and nested float bits/types, full-width IDs and zero-duration exceptions. Existing bank admission validation remains in force.
